entities.summary: Hassan Nour-el-Din Aman is an Egyptian-Chadian boxer. He competed in the men's light heavyweight event at the 1968 Summer Olympics. At the 1968 Summer Olympics, he lost to Jürgen Schlegel of East Germany.
